verse: yā vidyā guruvaktrasthā sūkṣmasthūlānuvartinī | sā vidyā kathayāmyadya tava snehena bhairava
melāpe militā sā vai gandhasya paramā citiḥ | (5) parā svarūpā paśyantī madhyamā vaikharī tathā
kathayāmi samāsena ambarāsvararūpiṇīm | yasya vijñātamātreṇa sa sthitijño bhaved dhruvam
ṣoḍaśāraṃ śubhāraṃ vai viśvagrasanalolupam | etaccakraṃ paraṃ vyoma sṛṣṭisthitalayaṃkaram
saṃhāraṃ tu idaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | antasthā *? smā? ṣānta vimarśasthā nirañjanā
vyomeśīnāṃ paraṃ divyaṃ labhate sādhakottamaḥ | tittastudyomyaṇaṃ piṇḍa kālikākramamuttamam
bhavāmi paramārthatve tad vadasva samāsataḥ | śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu deva paraṃ guhyaṃ yoginīnāṃ mukhoditam
sthānaniketakairmuktaṃ  nakṣatraiśca grahaistathā ||1/ 56 ||
kodaṇḍadvayamadhyasthe bindvante ca namo'stu te | brahmadvāre sthite kāli vasturūpe namo'stu te
navamena sthitisthena lāṃcchitaṃ kuru bhairava | tṛtīyametat kathitaṃ caturthamadhunā śṛṇu
sadāśivo  bhairavaśca   nāgairnāgavaraistathā  ||1/ 47 ||
pañcāśadrudrakhacitā catuḥṣaṣṭistu bhāvitā | sadāśivo mahādevo bhairavaścaiva saptamaḥ | pretatve saṃsthitā nityaṃ tasyā devyāstu sarvataḥ
(?) sārāt sārataraṃ sāraṃ tvatprasādādavadhāritam | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi vistāreṇa mahādhipe
tasmin sthāne ca suramye ādau pūjāṃ tu kārayet | yoginīnāṃ yathā nyāyaṃ ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu ekataḥ
mānuṣaiśca yathā tathyaṃ aśakyaṃ (?) tu kapāladhṛk ||1/ 48 ||
nutvā khacakramādyakaṃ kālākhyaṃ satatoditam | pūjayāmi yathānyāyaṃ devyāṃ saṃhārakālikām
raśmirūpā nirācārā bhāvābhāvakṣaye ratāḥ | khaṃ prāptāḥ śaktimārgena tad vada me trilocane
(?) yoginīnāṃ tu sadbhāvaṃ niḥśeṣaṃ kathitaṃ tvayā | siddhānāṃ tu yathā tattvaṃ hṛdgataṃ me padaṃ mahat
viśvanirmātṛrūpatvaṃ divyamānandarūpiṇam | kalā rūpāntā ekā vai catuḥṣaṣṭyantagā śivā
namo harthāntu tasyaiva mūlaṃ (?) saṃharaṇe kṣame | namo'stu te mahāraudri saumyarūpe namo'stu te
khatvāṅgaistu mahākādyairmuṇḍaistu  parivāritam ||2/4 ||
kiṃ vā śivagataṃ śāntaṃ kiṃ vā sarvottamaṃ dhruvam | kiṃ vā śūnyamaśūnyaṃ vā kiṃ vā śūnyāntarāntaram
tataḥ pūjyā maheśāna rājaputrāśca sādhakaiḥ | dvādaśa ca samāsena gurūddiṣṭena karmaṇā
etat jñātvā prayatnena guruṃ cārādhya yatnataḥ | tena tuṣṭena vai samyag yoginyastuṣṭamānasāḥ
vadasva  tat samāsena yathāvidhiranukramāt ||2/16 ||
avākyaṃ  tat  rahasyaṃ  vai dṛṣṭaṃ sthānavaraṃ  param ||2/3 ||
sṛṣṭisthaṃ pañcamaṃ yad vai saṃhārāt saptame yutam | daśamaṃ taṃ vijānīyād sarvakālakṣayaṃkaram
śāstropāyena nirmuktaṃ paripāṭyā vivartitam | na kulaṃ kulabhāvasthaṃ na śāktaṃ śāmbhavaṃ na ca
catuḥṣaṣṭistu deveśyāstattvarūpāḥ  parāyaṇāḥ  ||2/6 ||
madyapānaratāḥ kecicchavahastāstathāparāḥ | antamālādhalāścānya vaśābhaktyāstathāparāḥ | maṃjārudhirapūrṇāṃ tu asthiyuktaṃ tu bhīṣaṇam
kakalā kārgalārūḍhā daśasaptākṣarāntarā | parekokana he kādya kālākalmaṣva kālinī
gurupāraṃparāyātaṃ vyomeśīnāṃ ca hṛdgatam | akathyaṃ paramaṃ yat tu mahārtha buddhidaṃ sadā
jñānaṃ tu paramaṃ devī śrutaṃ me tvatprasādataḥ | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi vistareṇa vidhānataḥ
idaṃ cakravaraṃ vyoma trirūpaṃ triguṇodayam | trimārgaṃ tryavahaṃ nyantaṃ tristhānaṃ tu tridhāgamam
visargāntapadāvasthe sarveśvari namo'stu te | nādarūpe mahānāde sādākhyāyai namo'stu te
paramasiddhi ca padaṃ śuddhaśabdamataḥ param | bahuśabdaṃ tatoddhṛtya svarūpe ca padaṃ tataḥ
mantrātītā amantrajñā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | amātrā dvādaśāntāntā ṣoḍaśāntā punaḥ sadā
asya nyāsaṃ yathānyāyaṃ bāhyatastacchṛṇuṣva me | yena jñātena vai samyak sarvamantraḥ svabhāvataḥ
mukhād mukhagataṃ śūnyāmavyaktaṃ vyaktibhāvagam | sarvaśāstreṣu uddiṣṭaṃ anyagrantheṣu cottamam
pūjanīyā prayatnena saṃsiddhikārikā kṣiti | ? tatrasthā devadeveśyo vijñānakramayogataḥ
kiṃ vāsti paramā bhaktiḥ tasyaivārthasya kiṃ phalam | vadāmyasaṃśayaṃ tubhyaṃ pṛcchase tu yathā mama
sarvabhūtāstu sarve ca grastāstasmin  mahāhave  ||2/10 ||
tasmiṃ pitṛvane ghore mahābhairavasaṃkule | kālpāstu pālyamānā vai te sthitāstviṣṭacetā
aṣṭamena adhaḥkrāntaṃ caturdaśasamanvitam | sthitinavamavarṇena lāṃcchitaṃ piṇḍamuddharet
mahāphalgurudhireṇa dhūpayedarghabhājanam | mahātailena dīpāni dāpayedathavā niśi
etat jñātvā tu vīreṇa pūjayed bhava tattvataḥ | yena pūjitamātreṇa kālikākhyaṃ nirañjanam
bhairavarūpadhāriṇyo  vyomni vyomagatā matāḥ ||2/14 ||
varṇatrayodaśaṃ taṃ tu viddhi śatrunisūdana | sthitisthaṃ tu dvitīye na caturdaśamameva ca
siddhānāṃ yoginīnām tu tava vaktrāt maheśvari | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi siddhānāṃ sthiticakragām
tasmin pīṭhavare ramye śmaśānaṃkara vīrakam | mahācityagnisaṃyuktaṃ mahāmātṛbhirā
